text: Trade magic items, banners and followers with other factions through diplomacy. Here you can tune how the AI values these deals: item prices, the effect of the partner’s attitude, the deal memory, and an optional rule to trade only with a trade agreement.
Attitude: Order factions (% of the price)
Attitude: Destruction factions (% of the price)
Trade only with a trade agreement
Magic items, banners and followers can only be traded with factions you have a trade agreement with. Off by default.
How much gold one point of the deal evaluation is worth. Changes every price in gold. Default: 1000.
A demanded item worn by one of their characters costs this percent of its price more. 0 turns it off. Default: 30.
Points a faction asks extra after its first item deal with anyone; doubles with each further deal. 0 turns it off. Default: 5.
Extra cost of an item that goes back the other way soon after a trade, in percent of its rarity points. 0 turns it off. Default: 50.
From this many rarity points of both sides together, a deal improves relations like a medium gift (+20 relations) instead of a small gift (+10). Default: 35.
